pages.intent: the whole credit profile in one place
pages.message: Five years of volume, revenue by commodity, profit, cash flow and leverage, with the credit notes beside them

exhibits.reader_must_see: every line of the credit profile for all five years, grouped by block, with each line's growth rate at the end
exhibits.comparison: each year against the years beside it, and each line's five-year growth against the others
exhibits.data: 19 lines in five blocks by five fiscal years, mixed units (thousands, dollars, millions, percent, multiples), plus a growth column

forms_considered.form: one long table with block heads
forms_considered.reason: chosen: every figure the committee checks sits in one grid read across a row and down a year

forms_considered.form: small multiple line charts per metric
forms_considered.reason: shows trends but hides the figures a lender quotes and checks
splits revenue from the leverage it services, which the reader compares

exhibits.chosen_form: one long table with block heads
exhibits.why: a credit reader reads line by line and checks figures across years; one ruled grid with block heads shows the profile without turning
exhibits.marks: block heads on a pale band; the FY2021 to FY2025 growth column set apart; the revenue fall in FY2024 and coal's decline in brick red, which the notes column names

pages.intent: the covenant position and where the revenue comes from
pages.message: Leverage peaked at 3.93x in FY2024, 1.7% from the covenant, and fell to 3.18x as intermodal and chemicals reached 60.7% of revenue

exhibits.reader_must_see: leverage in each year against the 4.00x maximum, and how close FY2024 came
exhibits.comparison: each year's net debt to EBITDA against the covenant maximum
exhibits.data: one ratio by five fiscal years and one constant threshold

forms_considered.form: column chart with a threshold line
forms_considered.reason: chosen: the gap between each column and the line is the headroom, seen at once
carries the figures but the reader must subtract to see the headroom
five points draw a line, but a ratio at each test date is a discrete reading

exhibits.chosen_form: column chart with a threshold line
exhibits.why: the covenant is a line the ratio must stay under; columns against that line make the tight year visible
exhibits.marks: values on every column; the FY2024 column in brick red as the tightest; the covenant line in amber, named in the legend

exhibits.reader_must_see: the net debt and EBITDA behind each year's ratio, and the headroom each year left
exhibits.comparison: each year's ratio and headroom against the years beside it, the ratio against its two inputs
exhibits.data: two amounts, a ratio and a headroom percent by five fiscal years

forms_considered.form: four-line table aligned under the chart's years
forms_considered.reason: chosen: the figures behind each column sit under it and the reader checks the ratio

forms_considered.form: data labels for net debt and EBITDA on the chart
forms_considered.reason: three labels per column would crowd five columns and still drop the headroom

exhibits.chosen_form: four-line table aligned under the chart's years
exhibits.why: a lender recomputes the ratio from its inputs; the table puts them under the column they explain
exhibits.marks: the ratio row bold; FY2024's 1.7% headroom in brick red

exhibits.reader_must_see: both covenant tests for the last two years with the headroom left in FY2025
exhibits.comparison: each test's actual against its covenant, FY2024 against FY2025
exhibits.data: two tests by covenant level, two years and a headroom percent

forms_considered.reason: chosen: a lender reads covenant compliance as a table of test, level and actual
draws headroom but drops the levels the credit agreement states

exhibits.why: the committee checks each test against its stated level, which a table gives directly
exhibits.marks: the covenant column in amber; the FY2024 leverage reading in brick red

exhibits.reader_must_see: how the revenue mix moved between FY2021 and FY2025, and that coal shrank while the rest grew
exhibits.comparison: each commodity's FY2021 revenue and share against FY2025
exhibits.data: five commodities by two years, revenue and share, a growth rate and a total

forms_considered.form: mix table with shares and a totals row
forms_considered.reason: chosen: revenue, share and growth read in one row and the total ties out
needs five colours, one per commodity, and gives colour five meanings

exhibits.chosen_form: mix table with shares and a totals row
exhibits.why: the reader needs the shares and the totals as figures; a table keeps colour for meaning
exhibits.marks: coal's growth rate in brick red; the totals row bold under a rule

exhibits.reader_must_see: what the debt is, what it costs, when it falls due, and the cash netted against it
exhibits.comparison: each facility against the others by size, pricing and maturity, gross against net debt
exhibits.data: three facilities by amount, pricing and maturity, cash, gross and net debt with their multiples of EBITDA

forms_considered.form: debt table with gross and net lines
forms_considered.reason: chosen: the capital structure reads down to net debt, the figure the covenant tests
draws when debt falls due but drops pricing and the netting of cash

exhibits.chosen_form: debt table with gross and net lines
exhibits.why: the committee reads the structure top to bottom and checks it nets to the net debt in the covenant test
